description: This file contains utility methods for configuration management within the Orleans runtime, including IP address resolution, time span parsing, and connection string redaction.

classes.name: ConfigUtilities
classes.description: A static class providing utility methods for parsing time spans, resolving IP addresses, and redacting connection strings.

methods.name: ParseTimeSpan
methods.description: Parses a string representing a time span with optional units ('ms', 's', 'm', 'hr') into a TimeSpan object.

methods.name: ResolveIPAddressOrDefault
methods.description: Resolves an IP address based on subnet and address family, either from network interfaces or DNS.

methods.name: ResolveIPAddressOrDefault
methods.description: Resolves an IP address from a hostname or IP string, with optional subnet filtering.

methods.name: GetLocalIPAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local machine's IP address for the specified address family, optionally filtering by interface name.

methods.name: RedactConnectionStringInfo
methods.description: Redacts sensitive information from a connection string, such as keys and passwords, replacing them with a placeholder.
